notes: Split out 2026-09-02 from the combined multiace-afc-panel-sync patch (last combined version 2026.09.02.12) into a dedicated optional-enhancements-only installer. Requires the separate "Mnemonic3D's Orca MultiACE and Firmware Patches" installer (patch_sources.json) to already be applied to the target printer first - every group here originally declared requires: [orca-multiace-mandatory] and/or [tpu-ace-managed-touchscreen], which now live in that other installer and are assumed already present rather than re-bundled here. Contains: Mnemonic3D Recommended Printer Enhancements, Material-Aware ACE Rollback Enhancement, Mnemonic3D Calibrated Filaments, Panda Breath Gradual Warm-Up Boost, and the still-excluded-pending-approval Tube Length Calibration Wizard. .02: added the Mnemonic3D Dashboard Theme group - a purely visual reskin of the MultiACE web dashboard (index.html/style.css) matching the project's brand identity, built entirely on the existing CSS custom-property system already in stock style.css so no selector, layout, or JS behavior needed to change. Ships as alternate variants of the same mandatory multiace-web-index/multiace-web-css files (variant_group multiace-web-index/multiace-web-css), so installing it after Patches replaces the plain default look; the mandatory files themselves are untouched and stay plain unless this group is checked. Verified live on 192.168.4.33 across Dashboard, Spools, and the full Config page with no visual regressions before this entry was added. Per-material load/unload temperature preference (the request to let users blank out custom temps back to stock Snapmaker defaults) is handled instead via the live [ace_tipform] mode: stock/custom switch already built into the mandatory Patches installer's Config page - no enhancement-side change was needed. 2026.09.03.01: added the afc-panel-support group (afc-lane, afc-unit, afc-cfg, mainsail-afc-css), moved here from patch_sources.json's mandatory orca-multiace-mandatory group - AFC lane/panel display is not needed for Orca MultiACE edition to function, so it belongs in Features, not Mandatory.
_requires_note: multiACE 0.99.8b is now publicly released, so it is a hard precondition: this patch is the delta ON TOP of stock 0.99.8b. A printer below it must flash the 0.99.8b firmware first. Beyond versions, the installer's only other requirement is that it can write the files, and it updates just the ones that differ.
_groups_note: Added 2026-08-23 so the installer can offer per-fix checkboxes instead of all-or-nothing. Each group's 'files' list references file ids below by id. 'requires' lists other group ids that MUST also be selected - checking this group auto-checks those too, and they cannot be unchecked while a group that requires them is checked. This is deliberately a 'hard requires' relationship, not a soft suggestion: the files in a dependent group call directly into the files of the group(s) it requires, so a partial install would ship a broken half of a feature.

groups.title: Tube Length Calibration Wizard (Optional)
groups.description: Adds a guided tool to the MultiACE Dashboard. Before calibrating each slot, insert its filament normally like a fresh spool load and let the ACE finish its own automatic intake and parking cycle until the slot is ready and all ACE filament motion has stopped; the target toolhead must remain empty. Then choose that ACE slot and toolhead and confirm once. The printer performs two complete slow, sensor-checked load and verified-unload passes, including the normal toolhead seating and flow checks. Review the conservative result and choose Accept & save. The installer itself never moves filament. The existing learned route is cleared when calibration starts for safety, and the replacement calibration is not saved unless you accept it. V1 ACE hardware remains in safe slow-only mode.
items: The installer only adds the wizard; it does not move filament or run calibration during installation

Before calibrating each slot, insert its filament normally like a fresh spool load and let the ACE finish its automatic intake and parking cycle; wait for Ready with all ACE filament motion stopped, while keeping the target toolhead empty
On the MultiACE Dashboard, choose an available ACE slot and compatible empty toolhead, then confirm once
Runs two automatic slow, sensor-checked loads and two verified unloads; normal homing, tool selection, heating, seating, flow verification and purge may occur
Clears the selected route's old learned boundary at the start so an unsafe older value cannot return
Shows both conservative sensor-arrival observations and the proposed fast and slow sections before anything new is saved
Only Accept & save writes the new route calibration; failed, expired or discarded results leave the route slow-only
After saving, choose Calibrate next slot or Close; run it again after changing a tube, splitter, coupler, ACE connection or filament route

description_i18n.zh: 在 MultiACE 控制面板中添加引导式工具。校准每个料槽之前，请像装入新线轴一样正常插入耗材，让 ACE 自动完成进料和停放，直到料槽显示“就绪”且所有 ACE 耗材运动停止；目标工具头必须保持空置。安装完成后，选择 ACE 料槽和工具头并确认一次，打印机会以低速、传感器监控的方式自动执行两次完整装载和两次验证卸载。查看保守结果后，选择“接受并保存”。安装程序本身不会移动耗材；校准开始时会为安全起见清除所选路径的旧学习值，只有在您接受结果后才会保存替代校准值。V1 ACE 硬件始终保持安全低速模式。
description_i18n.ja: MultiACE ダッシュボードにガイド付きツールを追加します。各スロットを校正する前に、新しいスプールを装填するときと同じようにフィラメントを通常どおり挿入し、スロットが「準備完了」と表示されて ACE のフィラメント動作が完全に停止するまで、自動取り込みとパーキングを完了させてください。対象ツールヘッドは空のままにします。インストール後、ACE スロットとツールヘッドを選び、一度確認すると、プリンターが低速かつセンサー監視付きで2回の完全なロードと2回の検証済みアンロードを自動実行します。保守的な結果を確認してから「承認して保存」を選びます。インストーラー自体はフィラメントを動かしません。安全のため開始時に選択した経路の古い学習値を消去し、代わりの値は承認するまで保存されません。V1 ACE ハードウェアは安全な低速モードのままです。
description_i18n.ko: MultiACE 대시보드에 안내 도구를 추가합니다. 각 슬롯을 보정하기 전에 새 스풀을 넣을 때처럼 필라멘트를 정상적으로 삽입하고, 슬롯이 준비 상태를 표시하며 모든 ACE 필라멘트 움직임이 멈출 때까지 ACE의 자동 흡입 및 주차 동작이 끝나도록 하십시오. 대상 툴헤드는 비어 있어야 합니다. 설치 후 ACE 슬롯과 툴헤드를 선택하고 한 번 확인하면 프린터가 저속으로 센서를 확인하며 두 번의 전체 로드와 두 번의 검증된 언로드를 자동 실행합니다. 보수적인 결과를 검토한 다음 ‘수락 및 저장’을 선택하십시오. 설치 프로그램 자체는 필라멘트를 움직이지 않습니다. 안전을 위해 시작할 때 선택한 경로의 기존 학습 값을 지우며, 대체 보정 값은 사용자가 결과를 수락하기 전에는 저장되지 않습니다. V1 ACE 하드웨어는 안전한 저속 전용 모드를 유지합니다.
description_i18n.de: Fügt dem MultiACE-Dashboard einen geführten Assistenten hinzu. Vor der Kalibrierung jedes Slots legen Sie das Filament wie bei einer neuen Spule normal ein und lassen den ACE seinen automatischen Einzug und das Parken vollständig beenden, bis der Slot „Bereit“ meldet und jede Filamentbewegung des ACE gestoppt ist; der Ziel-Werkzeugkopf muss leer bleiben. Nach der Installation wählen Sie einen ACE-Slot und einen Druckkopf aus und bestätigen einmal. Der Drucker führt anschließend automatisch zwei vollständige langsame, sensorgeprüfte Ladevorgänge und zwei geprüfte Entladevorgänge aus. Prüfen Sie das konservative Ergebnis und wählen Sie dann „Übernehmen und speichern“. Das Installationsprogramm selbst bewegt kein Filament. Der alte Lernwert des gewählten Wegs wird zu Beginn aus Sicherheitsgründen gelöscht; die neue Kalibrierung wird erst nach Ihrer Bestätigung gespeichert. V1-ACE-Hardware bleibt im sicheren Langsammodus.
description_i18n.fr: Ajoute un assistant guidé au tableau de bord MultiACE. Avant d’étalonner chaque emplacement, insérez normalement le filament comme pour une nouvelle bobine et laissez l’ACE terminer automatiquement l’admission et le stationnement jusqu’à ce que l’emplacement indique « Prêt » et que tout mouvement de filament ACE soit arrêté ; la tête cible doit rester vide. Après l’installation, choisissez un emplacement ACE et une tête d’impression, puis confirmez une seule fois. L’imprimante effectue automatiquement deux chargements complets lents contrôlés par capteur et deux déchargements vérifiés. Vérifiez le résultat prudent, puis choisissez « Accepter et enregistrer ». Le programme d’installation lui-même ne déplace pas le filament. L’ancienne valeur apprise du trajet sélectionné est effacée au début par sécurité ; le nouvel étalonnage n’est enregistré qu’après votre acceptation. Le matériel ACE V1 reste en mode lent sécurisé.
description_i18n.it: Aggiunge uno strumento guidato alla dashboard MultiACE. Prima di calibrare ogni slot, inserisci normalmente il filamento come con una nuova bobina e lascia che l’ACE completi automaticamente l’inserimento e il parcheggio finché lo slot non indica «Pronto» e ogni movimento del filamento ACE non si è arrestato; la testina di destinazione deve restare vuota. Dopo l’installazione, seleziona uno slot ACE e una testina, quindi conferma una sola volta. La stampante esegue automaticamente due caricamenti completi lenti controllati dai sensori e due scaricamenti verificati. Controlla il risultato prudenziale, quindi scegli «Accetta e salva». Il programma di installazione non muove il filamento. Il vecchio valore appreso del percorso selezionato viene eliminato all’avvio per sicurezza; la nuova calibrazione viene salvata solo dopo l’accettazione. L’hardware ACE V1 rimane in modalità lenta sicura.

Tip-form changes are deliberately excluded so the printer keeps its existing stock behavior; the rejected broad/nozzle-size custom motion, second purge, pressure-relief retract and sensor-bypass experiments remain excluded.
groups.description: Mnemonic3D's recommended (optional) printer enhancements, on top of the mandatory Orca MultiACE patches. See the items below or click the README for full details on each.

Material temperatures - approved per-family nozzle-cleaning temperatures applied in memory; tip forming remains whatever stock firmware provides

ko: 순정 동작 언로드 청소 - 펌웨어의 순정 노즐 와이프를 한 번만 추가하며 압출, 리트랙션, 추가 퍼지, 거리, 속도, 팬 또는 재시도 시퀀스는 추가하지 않습니다

de: Entladereinigung mit Serienbewegung - genau ein zusätzlicher Durchlauf der serienmäßigen Düsenreinigung; keine zusätzliche Extrusion, Retraktion, Spülbewegung, Distanz, Geschwindigkeit, Lüfter- oder Wiederholungssequenz

fr: Nettoyage au déchargement avec mouvements d'origine - un seul passage supplémentaire de l'essuyage de buse d'origine ; aucune extrusion, rétraction, poussée de purge, distance, vitesse, ventilation ou séquence de nouvelle tentative ajoutée
Températures et formation douce de la pointe TPU - températures par matériau ; seul le TPU utilise la séquence ralentie calculée, les autres matériaux gardent les mouvements d'origine
it: Pulizia di scarico con movimenti stock - un solo passaggio aggiuntivo della pulizia ugello stock; nessuna estrusione, retrazione, spinta di purge, distanza, velocità, ventola o sequenza di ritentativo aggiunta
Temperature e formazione punta TPU delicata - temperature per materiale; solo il TPU usa la sequenza rallentata calcolata, gli altri materiali mantengono i movimenti stock

groups.title: Material-Aware ACE Rollback Enhancement
groups.description: Optional material-aware ACE motion caps. TPU ACE transport and its small retry pull-back are capped at 20 mm/s. The sustained TPU toolhead seating pushes and 80 mm purge are capped at 120 mm/min (2 mm/s or 4.81 mm3/s). During TPU unload, the first 100 mm of the existing sensor-clearing retract is capped at 10 mm/s and the remainder at 20 mm/s. ASA and ABS unload are capped at 40 mm/s, and PETG-family unload is capped at 50 mm/s. A printer already configured slower is never sped up. The material is resolved from the actual loaded head/ACE/slot, so no toolhead or slot is hard-coded. Total distances, the stock 150 mm sensor-check point, retries and temperatures remain unchanged. Direct/manual and non-TPU load/purge speeds remain stock. No tip-form engine or table is supplied by this group.
items: TPU ACE transport - maximum 20 mm/s, including the small load-retry pull-back
TPU toolhead seating + purge - maximum 120 mm/min (2 mm/s or 4.81 mm3/s)
TPU unload - first 100 mm maximum 10 mm/s, then maximum 20 mm/s
ASA and ABS unload - maximum 40 mm/s
PETG-family unload - maximum 50 mm/s
Safety - speed caps never increase a slower user setting and never change distances, sensors, retry counts or temperatures

groups.title: Mnemonic3D Calibrated Filaments
groups.description: Optional catalog for the 15 Mnemonic3D U1 MultiACE filament profiles. Adds the Mnemonic3D vendor and profile-identifying material/subtype choices to the MultiACE web and Orca synchronization paths. IMPORTANT - touchscreen tradeoff: the stock touchscreen firmware hard-codes exactly three vendor tabs (Snapmaker, Polymaker, Generic) with no room for a fourth, so this enhancement puts Mnemonic3D on the touchscreen by overriding the Generic tab's own button and material list. Generic's real stock list is 24 materials (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, PA, PCTG, PVA, PLA Silk, PLA-CF, Support PLA, PETG HF, PETG-CF, PHA, TPU 90A/95A/95A HF, plus BVOH, EVA, HIPS, PA-CF, PC, PE, PE-CF); once this enhancement is installed, the Generic tab is relabeled Mnemonic3D and only 8 of those 24 are kept (BVOH, EVA, HIPS, PA-CF, PC, PE, PE-CF, PETG-CF) - the other 16, including plain Generic PLA/PETG/ABS/ASA, are no longer selectable by name on the touchscreen. Snapmaker (including its own separate Basic PLA) and Polymaker are untouched. This only overrides the touchscreen's Generic tab specifically - the web dashboard and Orca sync are unaffected and keep every existing vendor. Exact Mnemonic3D profiles map to the same-named identity, future PA-family profiles map to Mnemonic3D PA (except exact Easy PA), future PC-family profiles map to Generic PC, and hard ACE-compatible TPU for ACE maps only to its exact identity with the 68D, 230 C nozzle, 45 C bed and 1.26 g/cm3 baseline. It does not select a filament for any slot, replace saved slot colors, rewrite filament_parameters.json, or alter the printer's saved calibration values. The parameter catalog is applied in memory only while this optional enhancement is installed.
items: PLA, PLA+, PLA HS and PLA Silk
PETG, PETG HS and PCTG
ASA, PA and Easy PA
PET-CF and PET-GF
TPU 90A, TPU 95A and hard 68D TPU for ACE

Touchscreen picker - OVERRIDES the Generic tab (relabeled Mnemonic3D): keeps only 8 of Generic's 24 stock rows (BVOH, EVA, HIPS, PA-CF, PC, PE, PE-CF, PETG-CF); Generic's plain PLA/PETG/ABS/ASA/etc. are removed from the touchscreen. Snapmaker and Polymaker tabs are not touched.

groups.title: Panda Breath Gradual Warm-Up Boost
groups.description: Optional Panda Breath warm-up control. Chamber targets below 50 C are unchanged. Targets of 50, 55 and 60 C begin at 60, 65 and 70 C; higher requests remain capped at a 70 C device target. The boost tapers smoothly during the final 5 C and latches off after the requested temperature is reached so later dips do not reboost. Both heater templates retain a hard 70 C maximum.
items: No boost below 50 C
10 C initial boost, capped at a 70 C device target
Smooth five-degree taper and no reboost after reaching target
Hard 70 C maximum in both auto and manual heater templates

groups.title: Mnemonic3D Dashboard Theme
groups.description: Optional visual reskin of the MultiACE web dashboard (Dashboard/Spools/Config tabs) to match Mnemonic3D's brand identity - teal and gold accents on a near-black background, Sora/Inter/IBM Plex Mono typography, and larger card corner radii. Purely a stylesheet and markup swap: every existing control, data binding, form field and behavior is unchanged. Ships as an alternate variant of the same two mandatory files (multiace-web-index / multiace-web-css) - Patches must already be installed, and this simply replaces its plain default look afterward. Requires the printer to reach Google Fonts over the internet for the exact typefaces; without internet access the theme's colors and layout still apply and text falls back to the browser's default UI font.
items: Teal (#0087A8) and gold (#E0A04B) brand palette, applied via the existing CSS custom properties - no selector or layout rule changed
Sora display type for headers and card titles, IBM Plex Mono for section labels, Inter for body text
Larger, more consistent corner radii across cards, buttons and inputs
Fixes a pre-existing undefined --text CSS variable on the reboot button (fell back to inherited color; harmless, but incorrect)

files.description: Optional material-aware speed caps layered on the same crash-safe occupied-head confirmation and strict load-verification controller. TPU ACE transport is capped at 20 mm/s; TPU unload uses the approved 10/20 mm/s speed stages, and ASA/ABS/PETG-family unload speeds are capped without changing any commanded distance. No route-learning, tube-calibration or 25 mm chunk controller is included.

files.description: TPU-enhanced authoritative ACE-mode boot template paired with the live filament_feed.py variant. S58multiace-mode copies this template into the live module on every boot; updating both preserves the TPU transport, seating and purge caps after a full power cycle.
